verdict.rationale: Persona documents re-running reports on a schedule against an account, explicitly giving the example of running a Watchlist Report monthly or yearly. Webhooks can notify on events for any Persona resource, and Workflows/Cases give ops a way to automate and act on results. Missing for 10: evidence that re-screening fires when watchlist sources update rather than only on fixed intervals, documentation of a specific event raised when a re-screen result changes or finds a new match, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
